application_credentials.description: At {apps_url}, create an app that does not use Power-up capabilities. On its OAuth 2.0 tab, create a confidential client. Add the callback URL {redirect_url} and enable the scopes read:member:trello, read:board:trello and write:board:trello. Then enter its client ID and secret here.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Trello again
reauth_confirm.description: Trello no longer accepts the stored authorization for {account}. Sign in again with the same Trello account.

boards.title: Choose boards
boards.description: Each board you pick becomes a device in Home Assistant, and each of its lists becomes a to-do list. You can add or remove boards later.
